subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should all workspace `.env` keys ending in `_ENDPOINT` be blocked as untrusted outbound-routing controls, accepting migration for Azure Speech, OpenTelemetry, and future integrations?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the hardening, but the protected change deliberately invalidates an existing configuration source across a broad current-and-future namespace.

options.title: Accept the generic endpoint boundary
options.body: Reserve `_ENDPOINT` alongside the existing routing suffixes and require affected operators to use trusted environment sources or explicit config.

options.title: Block only known endpoint variables
options.body: Preserve unknown workspace `_ENDPOINT` variables while explicitly maintaining the current sensitive Azure Speech and OpenTelemetry keys.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic endpoint boundary
recommendation.body: Reserve `_ENDPOINT` alongside the existing routing suffixes and require affected operators to use trusted environment sources or explicit config.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current centralized routing-suffix policy and its fail-closed rationale, making him the strongest history-backed owner for this boundary decision.
